decisionSummary: The Aug 19 dev-publish v28/2.0.33 source is canonical. It retains the newer rich TipTap/Yjs document release line and document-type resume repair, and closes the verified candidate-pack gap by binding the byte-writing action to the rich frontend and GrainContext bridge build. Main is the stable immediate ancestor. The divergent historical master, release, publish, metadata, and salvage refs were reviewed and contain an older alternate architecture, historical package evidence, or procedure material rather than newer runnable Document source.
